title: MultiPlot Graph
text: Plot results of multiple simulations, 1 input, {t-min} sets X-axis lower limit; {t-max} sets the x-axis upper limit, {y-min} sets the y-axis lower limit, {y-max} sets the y-axis upper limit, {Plot title} sets the figure title and {Workspace variable for export} sets the variable name for saving plot data. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Workspace variable for export
params.values: Variable name for saving plot data multisimout (default) | character vector
